description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange from 31.05.2021 to 06.06.2021
reasoning: This gazette notification announces new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically determining how customs duties and other charges are to be calculated based on currency exchange rates. The content involves legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
